transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I've been feeling extremely depressed and sad for the past six months, and it has just gotten to be too much. That is why I finally decided to come in and seek help today. I just can't seem to shake this heavy, dark mood.
Have you ever experienced periods where your mood was unusually high, energetic, or irritable, lasting for several days, even if you felt like you didn't need much sleep?

No, I have never experienced anything like that. My mood has just been consistently low, heavy, and depressed this whole time. I've never had those periods of high energy or feeling like I didn't need sleep.

Have you experienced these feelings of sadness and low mood consistently every day for the last six months, or have there been times during these months where you felt like your normal self for a few weeks or more?

I have felt this way consistently every single day for the past six months. There haven't been any periods where I felt like my normal self or got a break from these heavy, sad feelings. It has just been constant and unchanging.
During these past six months, have you also struggled with symptoms like a significant change in your appetite, trouble sleeping, difficulty concentrating, or feelings of worthlessness?

I have definitely struggled a lot with my concentration and focus, finding it really hard to do things like read or even follow a simple conversation. However, I haven't really noticed any major changes in my appetite, significant sleeping issues, or feelings of worthlessness.
Besides the difficulty with concentration, have you also noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in the activities you usually enjoy, or have you been feeling unusually tired and lacking in energy?

Yes, I've completely lost interest in all the things I used to love, and nothing brings me any joy anymore. I also feel constantly exhausted and drained of all my energy, making even simple daily tasks feel like a massive chore.
Before these past six months, did you ever experience similar symptoms of low mood, loss of interest, or fatigue that lasted for two years or longer?

No, I've never experienced these symptoms lasting for two years or longer in the past. This current six-month period is actually the first time I have ever felt this way. Before this started, I was doing okay.
